balls.text: another mishit drive from Dan. Just a single to covers.
drags this full delivery to long-on region
he moves towards off, opens his stance but misses out on this full toss outside off. he is cramped for room by that movement of his and ends up jabbing it to covers
Whack! he moved outside leg and creamed the full delivery on middle up and over extra cover
low full toss outside off stump, driven to sweeper cover.
pushes this to covers for a single
slips a full toss, dragged to right of deep midwicket.
full and dipping on Chritian who lunges out and only manages to squeeze it to the bowler
kicks up from short of length, lapped down to fine-leg region
just a single as he drives it hard but straight to long-off
Agarkar takes out Chipli. It was a length delivery around off stump. Chipli tries to heave this to the on side but top edges it to midwicket.
gets forward to drive this to long-off.
driven to covers for a quick single
full and in the zone outside off stump, Christian is beaten on the drive
leans forward to tap this to cover point for a single

JP is run out. He turned this to third man and returned for the second. The throws is flat and accurate and the keeper does the rest. Entertaining knock ends. He ambled across for the first run and decided late to turn for the second. Silly mistake.
50 up Blast! The JP shot. Duminy clears the front foot and murders this way beyond midwicket boundary.
moves outside leg and ends up scooping a full delivery over the bowler and it lands safely in the mid-on region.
dips full outside off stump line, dragged down to long-on
reaches outside off and digs out this very full delivery for a single
Humongous! . This is a full toss and Duminy has walloped it over long-on boundary
Bad ball. Slower bouncer goes awry. It was short and down the leg side. JP crash-pulls it to the backward square-leg boundary.  fine-leg was in the circle.
fullish, short of yorker length, squeezed out to extra cover
slightly slower full toss, eased down to long-off
full, driven but its intercepted at covers.
drives this to long-on for a single
How did it go to fineleg? He fetched it from around off stump and short-arm drag-pulled it to the fine-leg boundary. Ah replays confirm that I am going blind. It went off the inside edge.
fullish delivery, driven to sweeper cover
full again, dug out to mid-off for a single
yorker length on the middle and off line, squeezed through point
He goes again but this time doesn't get the elevation and the distance .. the ball lands well in front of the deep midwicket fielder
Crash bang wallop! JP time. He rushes down the track for the free hit and kills this delivery over midwicket boundary.

OMG  Another wicket of a no ball Christian went down the track and went for the slog. The ball lobbed off the top edge to backward point. The umpire had his doubts and went upstairs. No ball indeed. Two wickets off no balls this over.
full toss time! Bang. The ball is being picked from wide midwicket boundary

Turn Brad Hogg mode on- He would have screamed "J P is not happy!" He top edges the slog sweep and it's a simple catch to deep midwicket. Hold on JP Will be happy! That was a no ball!  The replays confirm that and Duminy is back. The crowd roar!
moves down the track, takes it on the full and drags it from outside off to deep midwicket
floated full and down the leg side for a wide. The keeper doesn't collect it cleanly
moves down the track for the big hit but once he realised he wasn't upto the pitch of the ball, he lunges forward to defend
gets back to clip it through midwicket for couple of runs
on the middle stump line, nudged to the on side
rotates the strike with an on drive to long-on
Fabulicious! That's the JP we know. He fetched this length delivery from the middle stump line and absolutely walloped it over midwicket boudnary
full and on the off stump line, JP smashes it to right of long-on who does well to get there and even puts in a dive but ends up pushing the ball to the boundary.
full and moving across JP who slashes it to right of third man. Edged away
around that off stump line, nudged to backward point
around the off stump line, jabbed back down the track
fullish, on the middle and leg, flicked through to Irfan at deep backward square-leg
Glen Salvi pushes this down the leg side for a wide
runs this down to third man for a single
gets forward to push this to the off side
tries to play the leg glance and it rolls away to fine-leg region. The umpire checks with him whether he got a touch on it ( that's my interpretation of that conversation) and signals.

Sanga's slog-mood has done him in. He was playing so so beautifully but suddenly started to play the across-the-line hoicks. This was full and on the leg stump line, so the shot to the leg was on but he would have normally whip-flicked it. Instead, this time, he tried to heave it but only got a top  edge to covers
And so James pushes this even further outside off. Wide, though.
Slog time! Edgy. He ran down the track and tried to slug this length delivery across the line. The lucky edge. And the ball runs past the leg stump to fine-leg boundary
slower cutter, pushed towards mid-off for a quick single
drifts to the pads, tickled towards short fine for a single
pushes this through covers for a run
lands on a length around middle and leg and moves across to outside off. Duminy is comprehensively beaten on the defensive prod. He was squared-up there ala Sarwan!
Duminy does the same to retain the strike
leans forward to whip it through midwicket for a single
Oh boy! he is in a great aggressive mood tonight. He goes down on his knee to sweep this to the boundary.
Bang! Sanga moves down the track, doesn't get to the pitch of the ball but decides to kill it. He flat bats it just to the right of the lunging Hopes at extra cover.
skips down the track and on drives it to long-on for a run
tries to drive this hard to long-on region but ends up dragging it down to deep midwicket
in the zone outside off, JP tries to steer it through vacant slip region but is beaten.
gets forward to ping long-off this time
Thrashed! Sanga clears his front foot, fetches the full-length delivery from outside off and smashes it to wide long-on boundary
The slower one, around 113 kmph, full and just outside leg; JP doesn't pick it and tries to flick it to the on side. The ball goes off the leading edge but lands safely at cover point
full in length, moving away from the off-stump line, JP square drives it to deep backward point region
full in length, eased down to long-on for a single
around a length, around that off stump line, tapped to point region
Dhawan tries the Sanga shot but fails. He leaned forward and tried to punch the back-of--length delivery over mid-on but the ball hits him high on the bat and lobs to mid-on.
shuffles across a touch - he has done it a few times today- and pulls the short-of-length delivery to deep midwicket
pushes this towards covers. Sanga wants a run, has to get back and manages to do it in time to beat the direct hit. Overthrows, though.
top edge but lands safely. Agarkar having no luck today. His fans will say that's the story of his life. It was banged in short and Dhawan edged his pull. The ball landed clear of fine-leg fielder
Dropped by Morne What a clanger! Sanga took couple of steps down the track and flicks the length delivery to right of short fine-leg where Morne makes a right royal mess

cuts in from outside off, from that round-the-stumps angle and this is the third time (iirc) that Dhawan gets an inside edge on the attempted cut. It runs down to fine-leg region. The angle cramped him
leans forward to lift this to left of long-off for a single
from round the stumps now, moving in with the angle, tapped to on side of the pitch and Morne rushes across to kill the thought of the single
he shuffles across again, Morne hits the short of length and gets it bounce over the leg stump., Sanga attempts the leg glance but misses
shuffles across and goes for the pull. But ends up lapping it to right of the keeper. He didn't get hold of that obviously
full in length outside off stump and Sanga drags it down to mid-on. He finds the fielder, though
shout for lbw but that looked high. It landed short of length and straightened on the middle and leg line. The ball moved past the prod and hit him high on the pad
The bouncer arrives and Sanga goes down under.
punches this on the up but the cover fielder intercepts
Another fine shot. It was a good length delivery moving away from Sanga who plays the on-the-up lofted hit over covers this time.
tries to clip this middle-stump delivery to square-leg and edges it to his body. Sanga calls him over for a quick single. He wants that strike. Here we go.
Ajitey! starts off with a full delivery on the middle, Sanga pings long-on
similar delivery and Dhawan plays the conventional square cut but can't beat point
banged in shorter, again just outside off, Sanga upper cuts it to third man
What a lovely shot! Treat! It's a length delivery around off stump and he leaned forward and lifted it ever so beautifully, ever so classically, over mid-off. Pure class.
Crashed! He cleared his front foot and slammed the length delivery on the up and to the left of the bowler.
edged over slips. Morne stares. It's a length delivery angling across Sanga who chooses to slam it over midwicket. The ball flew over wide slip
kicks up from back of length, moves towards off, Sanga gets behind the line to defend it back to the bowler
around the off stump line, punched down to mid-off
tries to heave this over wide mid-off region but makes no contact.
Lashed away! He went down on his knee and cut it through cover point in his inimitable style. Cut on the front foot.
tries to drive this one powerfully but ends up mistiming it to mid-on
leans forward to defend a back-of-length delivery to the off side of the pitch
length delivery outside off stump, Dhawan inside edges his cut to fine-leg region

He took couple of steps down the track, Irfan didn't lose his composure for once and continued with his outswinger plan. Sanga tried to chip it up and over the bowler but the ball curved away past the bat
stays behind the line of this length delivery and pushes it out to covers.
just outside off stump, steered to backward point
just outside off stump, slightly short in length, Dhawan goes for the cut but edges it to the right of backward point
Very cool! he is in some form tonight. It was the outswinger around off but he waited, covered for the swing, opened the bat-face and unfurled a stylish cover drive through point. Very neatly done.
leans forward to flick this full delivery to midwicket

What was that? Sanga tries the "idea shot" as its called in some gully cricket. He tried to leave a length delivery outside off all alone but was late in withdrawing the bat. The ball ran off the bat to the right of the keeper who does well to make a diving stop

Late on the pull. Done in for pace and the bounce. A gentle dolly of a catch to the keeper. Teja went for the pull against the short delivery and only managed to top-edge it high and the keeper settled under it. He tried to fetch it from well outside off and that also did him in
moves outside leg and has a slog at this one and the ball tails past the off stump
in the corridor outside off, Teja tries to square drive and is beaten
turns this through backward square-leg for a single
Crunchy! It was a length delivery on the middle stump line and Shikhar, aka babu as they call him, wafts it up and over the bowler. Imperious swing of the bat. Very nonchalantly done.
straightens on the middle stump line, from a length, tapped out to the off side
around the off stump line, steered to point region
full in length, just outside off, Teja goes for a big onside hoick and edges it to midwicket region
gets forward and across to push the length delivery to covers
around the off stump line, leans forward to tap it  to the off side
gets forward to dab this one for a single

shout for lbw but that was high. It landed on a length and straightened on the leg and middle line. Dhawan was beaten by the pace and by that straightening and was hit on the pad. I think it was high. Let's see if they show a replay. Replays in: It pitched outside leg stump
another one that moves past the prod and runs away of the pad
short of length, climbing outside off, edged away towards second slip

ha! yorker on the boot! It screamed full towards leg stump line, Dhawan didn't have any time to get his bat down in time and he tries to get his foot up and away from the line of fire. Too late. The ball rams into his boot
Edged this time, past second slip. It was a good-length delivery that moved away from Dhawan who stabbed out at it.

What a shot. Especially if you consider that it was the first ball. Shikhar Dhawan leaned forward to play a peachy extra cover drive. The front elbow high and lovely punch at the point of impact. It was a full pitched delivery
Delhi win! What a game. Nagar blasts this over the leaping long-on fielder for the winning hit.
on the middle and leg, turned through backward square-leg
stays back to tap this to midwicket

Nagar is  almost run out Does Sehwag have to score all the runs? full delivery, on the middle, whipped to left of deep midwicket region. Christian with a direct hit. Duminy was about to collect before he let it go and hit the stumps. Very very tight call. The bat seems to have just slid back inside. he dived forward near the end and dragged his bat in. Just in. Or so it appears.
reaches forward to force it to long-off
from round the stumps, on the middle, punched to long-on

Loud cry for lbw turned down. It was the googly that broke back in from outside off stump. The batsman lunged forward to defend and is hit on the pad. Need replays to confirm what happened there. A little big moment in the game. Looked close. Replays in: That's out. Looked plumb. It hit him on the off stump line and would have hit the middle stump.

Ah! nice. Done in by the googly! Irfan moved down the track but realised he had made a mistake. The googly landed short in length and turned away from Irfan. Panic time. He tried to lunge out and stab it but no luck. Sanga finishes the job Mishra started.
gets back to ease this to long-on
another googly, this time on the middle and leg and Hopes plays the powerful sweep shot to collect another boundary. Just nine more now.
googly but it slips down the leg side and Hopes glances it to the fine-leg boundary
just outside off stump, short in length, cut to deep point region
backs away and lunges out to drive through extra cover for a single. Lots of risk taken for a single and it was the last ball of Steyn's over. Hmmm
on a length around off stump line, eased to cover point for a single
cuts down the leg side for a wide.
lifting delivery and it flies through to Sanga
turned away for a single

Steyn takes out Sehwag, walks across towards the departing Sehwag and pats him on the back. Few other Deccan fielders do the same. What a tremendously entertaining knock this was. The end too came in pursuit of a six. He tried to pull this short of length delivery from outside off but edged it to a delighted Sanga. Stand up and applaud. Kill bill stuff indeed.
works this past square-leg for a single
at the rib cage, worked to leg gully region
moves outside leg, Ishant follows him, Sehwag jabs it to the off side for a single
a bouncer in the zone outside off, Sehwag arches back and tries to upper cut it but doesn't make contact
taps this gently to the off stump line and steals a single. Sehwag gets across and is slightly late in grounding the bat but he will beat the direct hit from Dan Christian
length delivery on the middle stump line, dabbed to the on side
length delivery outside off stump, left alone
on the pads, rolls to short fine-leg region.
another slower one, just outside off stump, Sehwag drags it to right of long-on where Dan christian fumbles. oh dear. What a mess.
slower one, on a length around off, wristed to deep square-leg region for couple of runs
Sensational hitting continues. She-whack! This has disappeared over wide long-on. Fluent clean swing of the bat.
Hammered! He leaned forward and deposited this over the straight boundary.

Whadaaaplayaaa! Complete entertainer. What a fiery knock  He mishit this length delivery to the midwicket region and comes back for the second. Warm generous applause. His first Twenty20 ton What a wonderfully violent and entertaining knock it has been. Supah cool!
fetches it from outside off and drags it to deep midwicket for a single
around the leg stump line, turned to square-leg

moves down the track, Amit pushes it well outside off and Sehwag reaches out to stab it away for a single. for a moment, there was a danger of him getting stumped but he reached out to get some bat on the ball
slower, loopy, on a length outside off and Sehwag lunges forward to drag-sweep it high over midwicket boundary!
tries to heave this from outside off to the on side but makes no contact
moves forward and hands the strike back to Sehwag with a drive to sweeper cover
hops  across a touch and drags this shortish delivery to the fine-leg boundary. Whaddaplayaaa!
short in length and bouncing outside off. Sehwag jumped but still couldn't ride the bounce but flashed it wide to the left of backward point. Steyn winces
connects this time and will get couple of runs
skids on outside off from a length. Sehwag tries to cut it but the ball bounces over the blade. Sehwag is angry with himself. Knowing him, it would be for missing out on a four!
length delivery on the pads, rolls away to short square-leg
slower one on the middle, dabbed to extra cover for a single
drags this behind square-leg for a single
Blasted! Sehwag advances down the track and kills it to the long-on boundary. One-bounce and it rolls over

Dropped by Ravi Teja at long-off. Mishra can't believe it! Sehwag rushed down the track and ended up slicing it to right of long-off where Teja did the work to get there in time but ended up clanging it
Thrash! He leans forward and crashes the leg break to wide long-off boundary.
stretches forward to turn it through backward square-leg
full and around off, Sehwag opens the bat-face to steer it to left of short third man
Stylish pull! He fetched the short delivery from just outside off and pulled it to the midwicket boundary.
shortish delivery, Sehwag doesn't connect properly with the pull and the ball rolls to the off. They hurry across for a single
tucks this wide of mid-on for a single
length delivery on the middle and off line, defended to the off side
The off stump has been pegged back. It was a length delivery on the off-stump line and Birt tries to late cut it. He misses it completely. Clatter!
full in length around off stump line, pushed out to covers for a single
on the middle and leg line, turned through midwicket for couple of runs
leans well forward to flick it to deep square-leg
collects a couple of runs with a cut to deep point
skids on outside off stump line, Sehwag presses back to cut it through backward point. Flashed away!

dropped  at sweeper cover! What a clanger! What a mess. Sehwag rushed down the track for the lofted hit but ended up slicing it to sweeper cover. The fielder moved in and palmed it off! Will confirm the name of the fielder soon
Huge! Very very high! Sehwag moved down the track for the violent six over the straight boundary!
on the off stump line, tapped to cover point for a quick single
Slam dunk! Its a length delivery just outside off stump and Sehwag knives it on the up and over covers
on the off-stump line, Birt crouches to slash it to third man
on the off-stump line, steered to third man
Risky! He walked across the stumps to a full-length delivery and just when he looked like he would be hit on the pad, he got his bat across to clip it to fine-leg boundary
moves outside leg, the bowler follows him., Sehwag tries to shuffle inside and goes for the pull. He doesn't connect well but will pick-up two runs
full in length on the middle, Sehwag keeps the strike by pinging long-on
leans forward to chip this uppishly but short of long-on for couple of runs
Drilled! Another slower one disappears. Sehwag waits and crashes this full delivery to the straight boundary.
the slower one this time but Sehwag waits, opens his stance and drags it to the cowcorner- between deep midwicket and long-on
Violence. Sehwag clears the front foot and smashes this full delivery over midwicket boundary.
Whippy wallop! The debutant hurls this full and just outside leg stump and Sehwag whips it up and over backward square-leg boundary
fullish, on the middle, on driven to long-on
fuller, around that off stump, steered to left of backward point where Duminy makes a diving half-stop
tries the bouncer this time and Birt is too late on the pull. The ball climbs over him
And again! Birt is edgy out there. Another iffy poke and the ball rushes past the edge
beaten! In the corridor outside off and Birt stabs thin ari
this time he allows the ball to pass through to Sanga
cutting away in the channel outside off, the batsman is beaten, playing away from the body
on the middle stump line but Sehwag has almost taken an off-stump guard. Off and middle may be. And he glances this easily to fine-leg boundary
in the zone outside off stump, left alone

Sehwag stands and watches his team-mates combust. This was a short delivery outside off and Venu went for another pull shot. Mistake. The ball flew off the top edge and Duminy settled under it at backward point
kicks up from back of length, Venu goes for the pull but is too late on it. The ball lobs up but falls safely ahead of mid-on
short in length outside off stump, punched away but straight to covers
short in length outside off stump, punched out to covers
shortish delivery and well outside off, Venu tries to slash it but makes no contact
fullish, outside off, Venu edges his off drive to midwicket but will collect a single
short in length around off stump line, defended to the off side
the bouncer outside off stump and the batsman pulls out of the pull shot. Wide given. Dan sledges the batsman who gives it back to him. The umpire asks them to cool down.
clips this through to deep backward square-leg region for a single
another wide down the leg side and Sanga lunges out to collect it
gets back to work it to midwicket region
just outside off stump, run down to third man
presses back to work this from the middle stump line to left of Chipli at short fine-leg
sprays this down the leg side for a wide. Sanga makes a half-stop
fuller, much fuller, on the middle and off and tailing away late, Venu gets a leading edge to third man; he was trying to work it to the on side
stays back to defend it to the off
Chance for  Duminy at backward point. It's a short of length delivery outside off stump, Venu punches and it just about dips in front of Duminy who doesn't quite lunge forward fully.
in the zone outside off stump, Venu holds his bat inside the line and allows it to pass through to the keeper

Edge and gone this time! Ishant banged this even shorter and kept it outside off; Ojha tried to repeat the shot he played last ball but this one climbed more ,kissed the edge and Sanga leaped to bring it back to the earth.

flashed over second slip! It was a back-of-length delivery just outside off, not much room to work with but somehow Ojha manages to get his bottom-hand working overtime and slashes it over that wide slip
gets behind the line to defend it to the off side of the pitch
tries the slower one, full and on the middle and leg line, on driven to right of mid-on where Mishra makes a tumbling save
stays back to defend this length delivery out to the off side
outswinger, full, and on the off and middle line, Ojha holds his balance to push it softly to covers
gets forward to push this to mid-on region for a single
moves back into the middle and leg line, moves past the waft and hits the thigh pad
fullish and just down the leg side, Sehwag goes for his whippy flick and misses. Sehwag stares down the umpire who eventually extends his arms.
around the off stump line, tapped to backward point
jumps to ride the bounce and punches it to covers
backs away a touch but is still cramped up as Ishant follows him; he pushes it to covers
gets down the track but plays his card too early. Ishant digs it short and the ball flies over the flashing blade. No ball , though. Free hit coming up
back of a length around off stump line, Sehwag punches but straight to point
Sehwag hops to clip this length delivery cutting into him to square-leg fielder
almost dragged on! It was a length delivery that cut back in from outside off and Ojha stabs it off the inside edge on to his pad

just past the diving second slip It kicked up from back of length and moved away from the off stump line. Sehwag hopped inside the line, opened that bat-face and steered it away from his body. The ball flew, the second slip fielder (Chipli) too flew to his right but couldn't get there in time.
stays back to jab to left of backward point region for a single
This one kicks up outside off and Ojha hops to stab it
shout for a catch by Sanga A screamer! It cut away late after landing on a length around off stump and Ojha was squared-up completely. What a lovely delivery. Not sure whether he got an edge there.
Lovely outswinger does the job. Aaron Finch went for the big cover drive but the ball curved away superbly to take the edge and flew to first slip. Steyn is pumped up!
full and on the off stump line, defended towards the non striker
